stories.title: （爱知·名古屋亚运会）综合消息：中国乒乓球队6金收官 中国队卫冕田径男、女4X100米接力

en.title: (Aichi Nagoya Asian Games) Summary: China's table tennis team finishes with 6 gold medals; China retains men's and women's 4x100m relay athletics titles
en.summary: China's table tennis team won six gold medals across seven events at the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games, claiming the men's singles and women's doubles titles on the final day. China also successfully defended both the men's and women's 4x100 meter relay athletics championships.

stories.title: （爱知·名古屋亚运会）亚运会乒乓球：蒯曼/王曼昱女双摘金 林诗栋男单夺冠

en.title: (Aichi Nagoya Asian Games) Table tennis: Kuai Man and Wang Manyu win women's doubles gold; Lin Shidong claims men's singles title
en.summary: China's Kuai Man and Wang Manyu defeated hosts Zhang Ben and Hata Hina 4-0 to win the women's doubles title. Lin Shidong won the men's singles championship by defeating defending champion Wang Chuqin 4-0 in his first Asian Games gold medal.

stories.title: 王毅会见日本国际贸易促进协会会长岩屋毅

en.title: Wang Yi meets with Japan's International Trade Promotion Association chairman Iwaya Takeshi
en.summary: China's Wang Yi, a senior Communist Party official and head of the Central Foreign Affairs Office, met with Japanese International Trade Promotion Association chairman Iwaya Takeshi in Beijing.

stories.title: Mexico could see life-threatening floods due to Hurricane Polo

en.title: Mexico could see life-threatening floods due to Hurricane Polo
en.summary: Hurricane Polo threatens Mexico's Baja California Sur state with severe winds, floods and mudslides as residents prepare for the storm. Meanwhile, Hurricane Nolo continues to pose a risk of heavy rainfall to parts of Hawaii.

stories.title: 泰国洪灾波及近180万人 已致8人遇难

en.title: Thailand floods affect nearly 1.8 million people, 8 deaths reported
en.summary: Continuous heavy rainfall in Thailand has caused flooding affecting 27 provinces and Bangkok across 151 counties, impacting nearly 1.8 million people. Eight deaths have been reported since September 16.

stories.title: 巴西市场上调2026年通胀预期至4.99%

en.title: Brazil's market raises 2026 inflation forecast to 4.99%
en.summary: Brazil's central bank released a report showing financial markets have raised their 2026 inflation forecast from 4.92% to 4.99%, while lowering economic growth expectations for the third consecutive week.

en.title: Xie Zhenye: men's 4×100 relay team achieves "one plus one greater than two"
en.summary: At the Aichi Nagoya Asian Games, China's men's 4×100 meter relay team composed of Chen Jinfeng, Zeng Keli, Wang Shengjie, and Xie Zhenye won gold with a time of 38.17 seconds, successfully defending their title.

en.summary: The 2026 Bank of China Beijing Marathon and National Marathon Championship is scheduled to begin on October 18 at 7:30 a.m., with a total of 32,000 participants.

en.summary: The 2026 FIBA OPEN 3X3 Beijing 3-on-3 Basketball Open final concluded during the Mid-Autumn holiday period. The men's and women's champions will compete in a national final to be held in Chongqing in November.

stories.title: US police report raises more questions about Chinese researcher Wang Danhao’s death

en.title: US police report raises more questions about Chinese researcher Wang Danhao's death
en.summary: A redacted police report has intensified questions surrounding the death of Wang Danhao, a 31-year-old Chinese semiconductor researcher at the University of Michigan who died shortly after a Department of Homeland Security interview in Ann Arbor.

en.summary: Multiple Chinese government and party organizations jointly held a National Day reception, with Wang Huning delivering remarks at the event.

stories.title: SpaceX’s Starship rocket reaches orbit for first time

en.title: SpaceX's Starship rocket reaches orbit for first time
en.summary: SpaceX's Starship rocket successfully reached orbit for the first time on Monday, despite an engine failure during ascent. The uncrewed test flight from South Texas carried upgraded Starlink satellites intended for deployment.

en.summary: Volkswagen Group and Chinese battery maker Gotion High-tech plan to invest €3.22 billion to establish three production lines in Europe and North Africa, targeting a combined capacity of 37.5 gigawatt hours of lithium-ion batteries.

en.summary: China's role in global electronics manufacturing is shifting as its concentrated supply chains disperse, but the country is retaining control of core industrial capabilities while exporting manufacturing processes.

en.title: AIIB plans to double financing by 2030. Can it bridge Asia's infrastructure gap?
en.summary: The Asian Infrastructure Investment Bank aims to double its annual financing to approximately US$20 billion by 2030 to address growing infrastructure funding needs across member economies.

en.summary: Hong Kong office tenants plan to hire more staff over the next year, but few intend to expand their physical office space, instead maximizing efficiency in existing premises.

stories.title: Chinese chip foundry CanSemi’s IPO oversubscribed 2,360 times as investors chase AI boom

en.title: Chinese chip foundry CanSemi's IPO oversubscribed 2,360 times as investors chase AI boom
en.summary: CanSemi Technology's Shenzhen IPO attracted massive investor demand with its retail tranche oversubscribed more than 2,300 times. The Guangzhou-based chipmaker is capitalizing on investor interest in silicon photonics and domestic artificial intelligence infrastructure development.
